title: WE BUILD eInvoice Attestation
description: JSON Schema for the SD-JWT VC claims set of the eInvoice attestation (vct: eu.we-build:einvoice:1)

iss.description: Issuer identifier (the Supplier's issuing system / EBW). Section 2.5.

exp.description: Technical expiry timestamp of the attestation (NumericDate). Section 2.5.

status.description: Token Status List reference for revocation (metadata, distinct from the business `status` attribute below). Section 2.5 / Chapter 6.

idx.description: status_list_index: zero-based index into the status list bitstring.

uri.description: status_list_credential: URI of the Status List Credential.

cnf.description: Holder key-binding confirmation (proof of possession by the Supplier's EBW at issuance). Section 2.5.

jwk.description: JSON Web Key of the holder (Supplier's EBW).

cryptographically_bound_to.description: vct of the Supplier's EBWOID attestation on the same Wallet Unit to which this attestation is bound. RECOMMENDED. Section 2.6 / Chapter 4.

attestation_legal_category.description: Legal category of the attestation. For this rulebook profile the exact value SHALL be `non-qualified-EAA`. Section 2.1.

invoice_payload_hash.description: Hash of the canonicalized invoice payload; binds the attestation to the external EN 16931 / Peppol BIS invoice (IR-EI-03). Section 2.2. NOTE: canonicalization method and hash algorithm are OPEN pending WP4 confirmation; sha256 assumed here.

invoice_format.description: Identifier of the invoice representation/profile used for the payload. Code list, Section 2.8.

invoice_number.description: EN 16931 BT-1. Invoice identifier, unique for the Supplier within the duplicate-detection window (IR-EI-04). Section 2.2.

issue_date.description: EN 16931 BT-2. Invoice issue date (RFC 3339 full-date). Section 2.2.

seller_legal_registration_identifier.description: EN 16931 BT-30. Reference to the Supplier's Legal Person identity (EUCC/LPID). Section 2.2.

seller_registration_name.description: EN 16931 BT-27. Registered legal name of the Supplier. Section 2.2.

seller_vat_identifier.description: EN 16931 BT-31. VAT/tax registration identifier of the Supplier. Section 2.2.

seller_country.description: EN 16931 BT-40. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the Supplier. Section 2.2.

buyer_legal_registration_identifier.description: EN 16931 BT-47. Reference to the Buyer's Legal Person identity (EUCC/LPID). Section 2.3.

buyer_vat_identifier.description: EN 16931 BT-48. VAT/tax registration identifier of the Buyer. Section 2.3.

buyer_country.description: EN 16931 BT-55. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the Buyer. Section 2.3.

buyer_electronic_address.description: EN 16931 BT-49. Address/endpoint identifier for delivery/receipt handling. Section 2.3.

amount_due_for_payment.description: EN 16931 BT-115. Total payable amount. Section 2.2.

invoice_total_vat_amount.description: EN 16931 BT-110. Total VAT amount for this invoice; SHALL equal the sum of tax_subtotal.tax_amount when tax_subtotal is present (IR-EI-07). Section 2.2.

invoice_currency_code.description: EN 16931 BT-5. ISO 4217 invoice currency code. Section 2.2.

tax_subtotal.description: EN 16931 BG-23. VAT breakdown, one entry per tax category/rate. Section 2.3/2.4.

payment_instructions.description: EN 16931 BG-16. Payment-related information. Contains sensitive payment data; issuer MUST make selectively disclosable. Section 2.3/2.4/3.2.

evidence_references.description: References to supporting evidence items (e.g. purchase order, delivery note). Section 2.3/2.4.

invoice_lifecycle_status.description: Business lifecycle status for corrections, cancellations and credit notes. If omitted, the lifecycle status SHALL be interpreted as `active`. Distinct from the registered `status` metadata claim used for Token Status List revocation. Sections 2.3, 2.8 and IR-EI-09.

preceding_invoice_reference.description: EN 16931 BT-25. Identifier of the original or preceding invoice. SHALL be present when invoice_lifecycle_status is corrected, cancelled or credited; MAY be omitted when the lifecycle status is active or omitted. Section 2.4 and IR-EI-09.

monetary_string.description: Monetary amount carried as a string to preserve exact decimal representation.

tax_category_code.description: EN 16931 BT-118 / UNCL 5305 VAT category code (EN 16931-aligned subset). Section 2.8.

taxable_amount.description: EN 16931 BT-116. Sum of net amounts for this VAT category/rate.

tax_amount.description: EN 16931 BT-117. Total VAT calculated for this subtotal.

tax_exemption_reason_code.description: EN 16931 BT-121. Standardized VAT exemption reason code (optional within group).

payment_means_code.description: EN 16931 BT-81 / UNCL 4461. 30=Credit transfer, 48=Bank card, 49=Direct debit, 58=SEPA credit transfer. Section 2.8.

payment_means_text.description: EN 16931 BT-82. Text description of the payment method (optional within group).

payment_account_identifier.description: EN 16931 BT-84. Payment account identifier (IBAN or other bank account number).

payment_card_pan.description: EN 16931 BT-87. Payment card PAN, masked or full (optional within group).

evidence_references_type.description: Type of the referenced supporting evidence item. Section 2.8.

evidence_inline_pdf_base64.description: Inline PDF evidence, BASE64-encoded (one of three supported evidence forms, Section 2.8).

evidence_inline_ubl_base64.description: Inline UBL evidence, BASE64-encoded (one of three supported evidence forms, Section 2.8).

evidence_uri.description: Publicly accessible URI of the evidence item (must be public; no protected-URI auth mechanism is standardized). Section 2.8.

evidence_hash.description: Hash of the evidence item referenced by evidence_uri, for integrity binding (IR-EI-08).
